fato_historico: 762: During the An Shi Rebellion, the Tang dynasty, with the help of Huihe tribe, recaptures Luoyang from the rebels.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a refreshing wind of renewal to your social circle. Much like an ancient city reclaiming its vibrancy after a long period of unrest, your mind may find clarity and peace. It is a good time to resolve lingering misunderstandings and embrace the harmony that follows when you truly connect with those who support your growth.
frase_do_dia: New beginnings often start in the quiet spaces of a healing heart.
significado_numero: Represents the power of building lasting foundations in your personal life.
conselho: Consider reaching out to a friend to mend an old bridge today.
